#set document(title: "Uday Pratap Singh Parihar")
#set page(paper: "us-legal", margin: (left: 0.65in, right: 0.65in, top: 0.55in, bottom: 0.55in))
#set text(font: ("Liberation Sans", "Arial", "Helvetica Neue", "Helvetica", "Arimo"), size: 10pt, fill: rgb("#1A1F2B"))
#set par(leading: 0.55em, spacing: 0.55em, justify: false)

#let accent = rgb("#1D4ED8")
#let icon-color = accent
#let subtext = rgb("#374151")

#set list(indent: 0.15in, body-indent: 0.5em, marker: text(size: 0.72em)[#sym.bullet], spacing: 0.55em)

// Section header: vertically centered title underlined by a single blue rule.
#let sectionhead(title) = {
  v(12pt, weak: true)
  text(font: ("Liberation Sans", "Arial", "Helvetica Neue", "Helvetica", "Arimo"), fill: accent, weight: "bold", size: 12.5pt)[#upper(title)]
  v(4pt, weak: true)
  line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#1D4ED8"))
  v(8pt, weak: true)
}

// Entry helper with vertical centering, matching jake's robust spacing.
#let entry(
  title-co,
  date,
  location: none,
  description: none,
  bullets: none,
) = block(
  above: 10pt,
  below: 0pt,
  width: 100%,
)[
  #grid(columns: (1fr, auto), align: (left, right), [#strong[#title-co]], [#date])
  #if location != none [
    #v(2pt)
    #text(size: 0.9em, fill: subtext)[#location]
  ]
  #if description != none [
    #v(3pt)
    #description
  ]
  #if bullets != none [
    #v(3pt)
    #bullets
  ]
]

#let skillblock(body) = block(above: 10pt, below: 0pt)[
  #body
]

#text(font: ("Liberation Sans", "Arial", "Helvetica Neue", "Helvetica", "Arimo"), size: 24pt, weight: "bold", fill: accent)[Uday Pratap Singh Parihar]

#v(2pt)
#text(size: 10pt * 1.6, weight: "bold")[Full Stack Web Developer · React / Next.js / TypeScript · Node.js / Python · AI-integrated web & mobile products]

#v(2pt)
#text(size: 0.9em)[#box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/location.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) Indore, India (open to relocating to Hong Kong) | #box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/phone.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) +91 88199 23334 | #box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/email.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) #link("mailto:work@udayps.com")[work\@udayps.com] | #box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/linkedin.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) #link("https://www.linkedin.com/in/uday-ps")[uday-ps] | #box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/github.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) #link("https://github.com/UdayPS-4o/")[UdayPS-4o] | #box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/website.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) #link("https://portfolio.udayps.com/")[portfolio.udayps.com]]

#sectionhead[Profile]
Full stack developer with 3+ years of hands-on experience shipping commercial web applications end to end. Founding engineer who owned the architecture, backend, dashboards and integrations of a live B2B logistics platform for two years; recently shipped AI chatbot features across a Next.js web app and React Native mobile app with LLM agentic workflows. Comfortable with real-time services, mobile-integrated web products, cloud deployment and Docker/CI, and reverse-engineering undocumented APIs when no SDK exists. Ownership mindset, fast cycles, code that runs in production.

#v(12pt, weak: true)

#sectionhead[Work Experience]
#entry([Software Engineer Intern, Tradyon], [May 2025 --- Jul 2025], location: [Bengaluru, India], bullets: [
- Shipped production features and fixes across web and mobile, improving chatbot UX and reliability in a fast Agile cycle.
- Built agentic LLM workflows in Dify orchestrating model calls with BigQuery-backed trade-data retrieval and response generation.
- Wired workflows into the app's data/services layer to deliver rich responses (text plus charts and graphs).
])
#entry([Founding Engineer, Delivo], [Jan 2023 --- Feb 2025], location: [Mumbai, India], bullets: [
- Owned the full stack: architecture, REST backend and database design, auth and role-based access, client and warehouse dashboards, external integrations.
- Shipped responsive dashboards turning live shipment data into actionable views for clients and operations staff.
- Integrated partner and carrier systems under international shipping compliance; handled deployment, monitoring and production support with cross-functional stakeholders.
])

#v(12pt, weak: true)
